'''Taylor''' (Japanese: '''テツオ''' ''Tetsuo'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP118|Pursuing a Lofty Goal!]]''.

Taylor was {{Ash}}'s first opponent in the [[Squallville PokéRinger]] competition. During their match, he used his {{p|Skarmory}} against [[Ash's Staravia]]. It nearly defeated Staravia with an {{m|Air Cutter}} attack, but a gust of wind pushed Staravia out of the way in time. Taylor commanded another Air Cutter, but Staravia dodged it and landed the ring on the goal, resulting in his loss.
